text_block_list.text:
But that's the best I could've done... So I
feel kind
of okay.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Nice work, McQueen. You beat me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
You really are incredible. I'm
disappointed
obviously, but I'm also
kind of happy, hehe...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ryan, happy even after a loss... That
carefree
expression on your face is a
curious thing.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
But it's only natural that I beat you at
this
distance. I've been working toward it
my entire
life.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The victory belongs to Мэдзиро МакКуин,
but the
battle to get there was a fierce
one.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Next, I'll surpass you in your specialty,
the
medium-distance race.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
A medium-distance race... Which one
would that
be? Any ideas, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
The medium-distance championship in
the spring
is the Takarazuka Kinen. In
response to Mejiro
McQueen, we make
that our goal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But in the end, it's the fans who will
decide what
happens, leaving us unsure
of how high we can
aim for.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
